desc:
Take your game (and your spirits) to the next level with the Pro Goy Tour flask. Designed for the discerning gentleman who appreciates both a solid round and a well-timed pour between holes. This compact stainless steel hip flask features Pro Goy Tour branding. The curved profile slips easily into a golf bag, jacket pocket, or cart console, keeping your preferred refreshment discreet and ready when the moment calls for it.

Whether you’re walking the fairway, waiting on the tee box, or celebrating a birdie in the clubhouse, the Pro Goy Tour flask delivers reliable performance with style.
